earliest_adoption_supported_by_blind_rea.label: D1
earliest_adoption_supported_by_blind_rea.statement:
Publish one result: “Saccharomyces cerevisiae Ima3p (BRENDA-linked accession P0CW40) had a specific activity of 3.9 μmol min⁻¹ mg⁻¹ on 5 mM 4-nitrophenyl α-D-glucopyranoside (α-pNPG) at pH 7.0 and 30 °C (mean of five experiments). Its relative velocity was 54% of that on isomaltose (7.2 μmol min⁻¹ mg⁻¹ = 100%).”

Keep 3.9 as the absolute value; its units come from the paper’s table heading, not the archive export. Relabel the worksheet’s 54 as a percentage. Both entries refer to the same published α-pNPG mean, so the worksheet adds no independent measurement.

Leave the enzyme-source strain unknown. S288c is the genome discussed, not an established source strain for this result. Record CEN.PK113-5D separately as the expression host.

Deng et al., FEBS Open Bio 4 (2014), 200–212, DOI 10.1016/j.fob.2014.02.004, PMID 24649402, PMCID PMC3953731: Table 2 (JATS t0010), Ima3p column, α-pNPG “3.9 (54)” and Isomaltose “7.2 (100),” with heading and table note; Introduction (s0005) for S288c; Experimental procedures (s0080) for the expression host.

earliest_adoption_supported_by_blind_rea.label: D2
earliest_adoption_supported_by_blind_rea.statement: Correct W1 and count one published α-pNPG result. BRENDA 2026.1, entry 3.2.1.10/specific_activity/59 (E1), records 3.9 for Saccharomyces cerevisiae, accession P0CW40, and links PMID 24649402. The archive unit and strain fields are blank. Deng et al., FEBS Open Bio 4 (2014), 200–212, DOI 10.1016/j.fob.2014.02.004, PMCID PMC3953731, Table 2 (JATS t0010), Ima3p column, gives “3.9 (54)” for α-pNPG and “7.2 (100)” for isomaltose. The heading supplies μmol/min/mg. The note defines relative velocity, and 100 × 3.9/7.2 rounds to 54%. Both entries trace to that same α-pNPG mean of five experiments at 5 mM 4-nitrophenyl α-D-glucopyranoside, pH 7.0 and 30 °C. Keep Ima3p and the archive accession. Leave source strain unknown. The Introduction (s0005) discusses the S288c genome and Experimental procedures (s0080) identifies CEN.PK113-5D as the expression host. Publish 3.9 μmol/min/mg as the specific activity of S. cerevisiae Ima3p (P0CW40) on 5 mM α-pNPG at pH 7.0 and 30 °C, mean of five experiments. Publish 54% as its velocity relative to Ima3p on isomaltose (7.2 μmol/min/mg, 100%). Link both fields to one published α-pNPG result. Record CEN.PK113-5D as the expression host.

earliest_adoption_supported_by_blind_rea.label: D2
earliest_adoption_supported_by_blind_rea.statement: BRENDA 2026.1 row 3.2.1.10/specific_activity/59 gives 3.9 for the yeast enzyme on α-pNPG at pH 7 and 30 °C and links PMID 24649402. Its unit and strain fields are blank. Publisher return E2 for Deng et al., FEBS Open Bio 4 (2014), 200–212, DOI 10.1016/j.fob.2014.02.004, PMCID PMC3953731, Table 2 (JATS t0010), gives “3.9 (54)” and “7.2 (100)” in the Ima3p column for α-pNPG and isomaltose. The heading supplies μmol/min/mg. The note identifies the denominator, conditions and mean of five experiments. The ratio 100 × 3.9/7.2 rounds to 54%. The Introduction (s0005) identifies S288c as genome context. Experimental procedures (s0080) identify CEN.PK113-5D as expression host. Publish a single α-pNPG result. Saccharomyces cerevisiae Ima3p (archive accession P0CW40) had a mean specific activity of 3.9 μmol/min/mg with 5 mM 4-nitrophenyl α-D-glucopyranoside at pH 7.0 and 30 °C (five experiments). Retain W1’s 54 as relative velocity in percent of the same enzyme’s isomaltose value (7.2 μmol/min/mg = 100%). W1 adds zero independent measurements. Remove the S288C strain assignment, leave the source strain unknown and record CEN.PK113-5D in the expression-host field.
